case.title: How BCA moved its committee
case.lede: The Bengali Cultural Association in Oslo runs its festivals, tickets, members and committee from one website, run by volunteers.
case.challengeText: A cultural association is run by volunteers who have other jobs. Announcing events, selling tickets, keeping the member list and showing the committee used to mean several separate tools, and someone had to keep them all in step before every festival.
case.quote: Before, every festival meant three spreadsheets and a lot of late-night messages. Now the committee opens one page, and the tickets, the members and the programme are all there.
case.quote2: I remember when we printed every notice and posted it by hand. Today a new family finds us online, joins in a few minutes and buys a festival ticket with Vipps.
case.resultText: BCA Oslo now has one website with its own look, where events, tickets paid with Vipps, membership, the committee and the photo gallery live side by side. A new volunteer learns one place, and the committee changes the site without a developer.

Nobody can sign in, edit or export until you wake the site up, which takes a minute or two. Sales, sign-ups and background jobs (newsletter, payment checks) stop. Nothing is deleted. eventPass.exportNote: We only learn that you said yes, never what is in your reports. The accounting report is a record and an export, not bookkeeping software: you are responsible for keeping your accounting records as long as the law of your country requires.
eventPass.exportToast: Noted. Remember to keep the file safe.
eventPass.upgradeBody: Become a full square with Live hosting. The {credit} you paid for the Event pass is credited, nothing is deleted and the site goes back to live.

dashboard.note: Events, orders and members are managed inside the square's own admin.

theme.title: Theme
theme.lede: The look of your square's public site.
theme.fixed: Changing the theme changes the look and layout of your public site. Your content, modules and data stay as they are.
theme.saved: Theme applied. Your site shows it within a minute; reload it to see it.
theme.lede2: The look of your square's public site. Pick one and check the preview before you apply it.
theme.appliedBody: Your public site now uses it. Content, modules and data are unchanged.
theme.retired: {theme} is no longer offered to new squares. Your site keeps working with it; if you switch to another theme you cannot switch back.
theme.previewNote: Applying changes the look and layout of your public site. Your content, modules and data stay as they are. Preview uses sample content.
theme.noMatchBody: Try another word or clear the layout filter.
theme.mainSub: Shown in the header, footer and tab icon of your site.
theme.mainHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Without one, the site shows the first letter of your name.
theme.darkSub: Shown in the footer and in dark mode.
theme.darkHint: Without one, the main logo is used.
theme.liveTitle: Live preview of the {theme} theme on your site
theme.liveLoadingSub: Setting up sample content in this theme
theme.liveOffTitle: The preview isn't available right now
theme.liveOff: The live preview shows your real site in this theme. Your choice is not affected; try again in a moment.

studio.title: Theme Studio
studio.leaveBody: You have changes that are not saved. If you leave now they are lost.
studio.loaded: Loaded into the editor. Change it, then save.

landing.lede: This is the look {name} wears on your public site now.
landing.asDesigned: The theme as it was designed. Nothing of your own is added.
landing.draftOn: A draft is shared by a private link
landing.goNote: The studio fills the whole window, so you can try themes, colours, fonts and more beside a live preview.
landing.seasons: {n} seasonal look saved | {n} seasonal looks saved

theme.lede3: {name} · the look of your public site. Changes show in the preview; nothing goes live until you save.
theme.tabThemeLede: The theme sets the layout and the starting colours of your site. Your own colours, fonts and shapes go on top of it.

look.title: Your own colours and fonts
look.lede: On top of the theme you picked: a colour scheme and a pair of fonts. The preview changes at once; nothing changes on your site until you save.
look.locked: Your own colours and fonts are in the Square package and above. The theme itself stays free to change.
look.readableDark: This theme opens dark, so these three colours describe its dark look; the light look is made from them. Text stays readable whatever you pick: the site adjusts a colour that is too close to its background.
look.readable: Text stays readable whatever you pick: the site adjusts a colour that is too close to its background. Dark mode is made from the same three colours.
look.fontHead: A place to meet, make and share
look.fontText: A friendly society for neighbours who like good company, good food and a good reason to leave the house.
look.adminFixed: Fonts apply to your public site. The admin console and member pages keep their own fixed fonts.
look.feelLede: How your site behaves: whether it starts light or dark, how much room there is between sections, how big the text is, how much moves, and how sections are divided. Click an option to choose it, click it again to go back to the theme as designed.
look.feelAdmin: Feel applies to your public site. The admin console and member pages keep their own spacing and their own light/dark switch.
look.feel_mode: Light or dark to start in
look.backPart: Back to the theme as designed
look.demoMotion: Sample: hover the box, watch the strip
look.swCaption: Each chip shows three colours, left to right: Page (the background), Text and Accent (buttons and links).
look.typeLede: Choose any font of Google Fonts for the headings and for the text, and a font for the small handwritten lines above a title. What you leave empty keeps the pair above.
look.typeGoogle: The fonts are loaded from Google Fonts.
look.pickerFailed: The list of fonts could not be loaded. Try again.
look.pickerMore: the first {n} are shown, search to narrow it down
look.startsDark: A look sets the colours for Light and for Dark. Picking one replaces your own dark colours with its dark side; Discard changes brings them back.
look.darkSet: You have your own dark mode colours, so these choices change the light look only. To see them, switch the preview to Light.
look.darkLede: Visitors who use dark mode see these. By default rootsquares makes the dark look from your three colours; here you can choose it yourself.

seasons.title: Seasonal looks
seasons.lede: A look that your public site wears between two dates and then leaves, for example for Diwali or Christmas. Build the look in the tabs, then save it as a season.
seasons.add: Add a season from the editor
seasons.name: Name
seasons.fromEditor: The season gets the look in the editor now, including the theme picked on this page.
seasons.useEditor: Replace its look with the editor now
seasons.empty: Choose something in the tabs first.
seasons.loaded: The season is in the editor. Change it, then update the season (Change, then tick Replace its look).
seasons.note: Days count in UTC, so the look can change a few hours from your local midnight. Where seasons overlap, the first in the list wins. A season replaces the whole live look and theme while it is on; the visitors who hold a draft link still see the draft.
seasons.endBefore: The last day cannot be before the first day.
seasons.confirmBody: The season is deleted. If it is on today, your site goes back to its saved look.

draft.title: Share a draft with your committee
draft.lede: Try a look, then share a private link. Anyone with the link sees the site with this look; everybody else still sees the live one. Nothing goes live until you publish.
draft.empty: Choose something in the tabs first, then share it.
draft.passcodeHint: 4 to 40 characters. People with the link are asked for it.
draft.passcodeNone: No passcode: anyone with the link can see the draft.
draft.passcodeChange: New passcode (leave empty to keep it)
draft.save: Save as draft and get the link
draft.update: Update the draft with the editor
draft.expires: The link works until {date}. Saving the draft again starts the 14 days again.
draft.expired: This link has expired. Save the draft again to open it for 14 days.
draft.load: Load the draft into the editor
draft.publishAsk: This replaces your live colours, fonts, shapes, feel and spinners with the draft, and the link stops working.
draft.removed: The draft is down; its link no longer works.
draft.saved: Draft saved. Send the link to your committee.
draft.loaded: The draft is in the editor. Change it, then save look or update the draft.
draft.note: A draft is the whole look you see in the preview: the theme, colours, fonts, shapes and feel (the spinners show once it is published). Publishing replaces everything live with it.
draft.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. It is selected: press Ctrl+C (or Cmd+C) to copy it.
draft.showPass: Show the passcode while I type

passcode.title: Remove the passcode?
passcode.body: Anyone with the link will then see the draft without a passcode.

renew.title: Make a new link?
renew.body: The old link stops working at once. Send the new link to your committee again.

remove.title: Take the draft down?
remove.body: The draft is deleted and its link stops working. Your live site does not change.

look.startsLede: A ready-made set of colours, fonts, shapes and feel to start from. Click one and the preview changes at once; nothing changes on your site until you save.
look.startsNote: A starting look fills the Colours, Fonts, Shapes and Feel tabs, so you can change any part afterwards. It keeps your theme and your spinners.
look.shapesLede: The shape of buttons, cards, photo frames and edges on your public site, on top of the theme. Click an option to choose it, click it again to go back to the theme as designed. Colours and text sizes never change.
look.shapesAdmin: Shapes apply to your public site. The admin console and member pages keep their own corners.
look.spinnersLede: The spinner shows while a page is loading. Keep the ones that suit your group; with several kept, each loading screen picks one of them. Nothing kept: the nine of the festival set. On your site a spinner takes the colours of your theme.
look.coloursLede: Sits on top of the theme. Dark mode is made from the same three colours.
look.saved: Saved. Your site shows it within a minute; reload it to see it.
look.back: Back to the theme's own look
look.cleared: Back to the theme's own look. Your site shows it within a minute; reload it to see it.
look.hexBad: Not a colour. Use six digits after the #, for example #1a2b3c. The last good colour is kept.

modules.notReady: Modules can be changed once the square is ready.

domain.customSoon: Connecting your own domain (with the DNS records to copy and a check) is not available yet. Your square works on its rootsquares address meanwhile.

billing.lede: Your plan, what each plan includes, and your payments.
billing.soon: Payments are in test mode. Nothing is charged while rootsquares is being tested.

settings.name: Name
settings.soon: The name, short name and currency cannot be edited from here yet. The square's own admin holds its day-to-day settings.

support.lede: Let rootsquares staff look at your square for a short time, only when you allow it.
support.soon: Granting and revoking support access (1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days) and its audit log are not built yet. rootsquares staff have no access to a square's data.
